changelog: **Semantic match rule, the scoring half (#2038, story #2019):** new soft dimension `semanticAffinity` in the #1781 registry — it compares two people's cached profile THEMES (`ProfileDigest.themes`, new tenant model: `userId @unique`, `digest`, `themes`, `sourceHash`, `model`) with deterministic arithmetic in the pure, client-safe `src/lib/matching/semantic.ts` (an exact theme counts 1, a theme sharing a significant word counts ½, over the mentee's themes) and names the shared themes in the breakdown row. No provider call happens at query time; a person without a digest leaves the rule not applicable (the same 0 for everybody), and weight 0 reproduces the ranking without the rule exactly. The rule is soft-only (`SOFT_ONLY_DIMENSIONS`): the rule-set schema refuses a hard kind for it and the scorer reads a stray one as weighted; the `/admin/matching` editor locks its kind. The pool loaders read the digest in the same query as the person, so suggestions, the dry run, the cohort pass, swaps and decision records all score it. Not in the built-in default set — an org adds it with its own weight. Account erasure deletes the digest. Generation of the digests (the AI task, refresh job, and a person's own read/regenerate) follows in the next slice.
